annotations.title: Quote a rental for a date and ZIP

description: Build a complete, real quote for one rental on a specific date and delivery zip: exact dated item price, availability, delivery fee, that date's minimum order, the total, and the booking link. Use this the moment you know the product, the date and the zip - it is the fastest way to answer 'how much?' properly. If you are missing the date or zip, ask the customer for it (never guess a zip from their IP or city) and then call this.

coupon.description: Optional: CHAT10 once you have offered it, or a code the customer typed. Returns with_coupon, the exact discounted total, so you never do discount math yourself.

end_time.description: When the party ends, in their words ("1pm"). For an attended rental, when it should stop running - not the pickup time.

items.description: Two or more items for the SAME party: pass them all here (product_name = the first one) to get ONE order total with one delivery fee. Never add up separate quotes.

quantity.description: How many of this item, default 1

start_time.description: When the party starts, in their words ("10am", "2:30pm"). For a rental with an attendant (mechanical bull etc.), when it should start running. Pass start_time AND end_time whenever they have said them: the price depends on party length.

zip.description: 5-digit delivery zip the customer gave you
